threshold_rule: One fixed threshold before analysis: abs(GT increment)>1e-4 rad. Report component and motion-energy coverage plus continuous cosine/gain/RMS.

semantics.backend: composed expert-command prediction(t)-actual pre-action target(t), same command space for A/B
semantics.hold: Hold the actual current observation relevant to that predictor, not a simulated autonomous policy
semantics.plan_start_hold: DP-only fair 5Hz information baseline: hold observed q for A or actual pre-action target for B from that chunk planning tick. Verified recorded cursor0..11; all12 cursors reported. Current-observation hold additionally uses fresh60Hz observations unavailable to the frozen chunk.
semantics.cursor0: First predicted A target is actual configuration after the next60Hz control transition; B is the expert absolute command target after the current action. Neither first target is required to equal the current q or pre-action target. Hold comparisons measure prediction accuracy, not an equality contract.
semantics.contact: Real same-transition object-contact force>0.1N at either physics sample; diagnostic phase labels only, never student inputs
semantics.masks: Before contact/first12/next12/after24 partition each episode. First24 combines first12+next12; native stages and all are separate overlapping summaries.
semantics.ratios: Gain and cosine use all components without the threshold. Direction and nearzero fractions use effective GT components. Nearzero prediction means abs(delta)<=1e-4 rad. Same-direction counts any same-sign prediction, including nearzero predictions; these fractions are nonexclusive and must not be summed as a partition. Opposite-direction excludes nearzero predictions. These original metric definitions are unchanged.

scope: Original fixed first2 training episodes and same6 validation families used for model selection, not untouched test. Each selected backend recomputes complete recorded history with current parameters. DP commitments come from hash-verified current full-frame caches. Offline increments and their sums do not execute a rollout or identify causal task failure. A/B DP label spaces differ; compare DP only within each role.
compact_scope: All aggregate metrics and all12 DP cursor metrics; per-family arm/hand metrics for all/first12/next12/first24 contact; validation all29 joint metrics and first24 per-family index/thumb/ring joints. Other case phases and train2 joint detail remain in the original full report. Tables map columns to each row without numeric rounding.

A.binding_checks: Exact cache identity; config base/statistics hashes; frontend model and EMA/backend normalization buffers; observation/transition/cache timestamps; next-step q_reached; first remaining plan; complete legal masks and control segments.

selected.selection: fixed validation6 all-tick normalized equal Arm/Hand MSE

B.binding_checks: Exact cache identity; config base/statistics hashes; frontend model and EMA/backend normalization buffers; observation/transition/cache timestamps; next-step q_reached; first remaining plan; complete legal masks and control segments.

selected.selection: fixed validation6 all-tick normalized equal Arm/Hand MSE

audit_revision.reason: Explicit original nonexclusive direction fractions; unique fixed train2/validation6 guards; exact cache, normalization, timestamp and same-transition label checks incorporated.
